data.one_liner: YarnSpinner narrative game tools equivalent for Dart and Flame.
data.what_it_does: Supports building dialogues, interactive conversations, narratives, or non-linear storytelling. It loads text-based Yarn language files into a YarnProject and presents the dialogue to users within a game or app.
use_when: You are building a game with interactive, non-linear dialogues.
You want to use Yarn Spinner syntax for narrative writing in Dart.
avoid_when: You are building standard business or utility apps without game narratives.
You do not use text-based Yarn files for dialog scripts.
strengths: Equivalency to Yarn Spinner for Unity ecosystem.
Easily handles conversations, branching dialogues, and narrative flows.
weaknesses: Niche application limited primarily to narrative games.
Requires writing scripts in external Yarn format files.
